risk_description:
Certain spot-welds were missed during the welding of the body panels to the left and right front shock absorbers.
As a result, cracks and breakage may occur on other spot-welds and/or on the body panels around the front shock absorber mounting areas. This could cause a front shock absorber to separate from the mounting area, resulting in a loss of vehicle driving stability, increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of Motor Vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
